definitions.explanation: Refers to both parents together. This is a neutral term that can be used when talking about one's own parents or someone else's parents.

examples.japanese: {両親|りょうしん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{両親|りょうしん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}しました→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧。
{両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}しています→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
{両親|りょうしん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
ご{両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give my regards to your parents.
examples.notes: ご両親 is the honorific form

notes:
{両親|りょうしん} means parents - referring to both mother and father together.

WORD FORMATION:
{両|りょう} (both) + {親|しん} (parent) = both parents

FORMALITY:
- {両親|りょうしん}: standard/formal
- ご{両親|りょうしん}: honorific (for others' parents)
- {父|ちち}と{母|はは}: my father and mother (casual)
- お{父|とう}さんとお{母|かあ}さん: dad and mom (casual)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {両親|りょうしん}に{感謝|かんしゃ}する: to be grateful to one's parents
- {両親|りょうしん}を{養|やしな}う: to support one's parents
- {両親|りょうしん}に{会|あ}う: to meet one's parents
- ご{両親|りょうしん}によろしく: give my regards to your parents

RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
- {父親|ちちおや}: father
- {母親|ははおや}: mother
- {親|おや}: parent(s)
- {片親|かたおや}: single parent
- {義理|ぎり}の{両親|りょうしん}: in-laws

NOTE:
When talking about your own parents to others, use {両親|りょうしん}, {父|ちち}, {母|はは}. When asking about or referring to someone else's parents, use ご{両親|りょうしん}, お{父|とう}さん, お{母|かあ}さん.
